b2 / about

A little about how I work & why

Bio

I'm a frontend developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, focused on building interfaces that feel effortless. I care about the small details — the easing curve on a hover, the spacing between two lines of text — because those details are what make a product feel finished.

Education

  • B.Sc. in Computer ScienceNorthern University Bangladesh, 2024
  • Frontend Web DevelopmentSelf-taught + online mentorship, 2023

Interests

UI Design Photography Chess

Goals

Over the next year, I'm aiming to deepen my craft in design systems and motion, contribute to open-source UI libraries, and work with teams who care as much about polish as I do.
